name: Semi-Supervised Five-Encoder Shared-Private Product-of-Experts VIB
summary: Each patient is represented by five foundation-model mean embeddings whitened inside training folds using labelled and unlabelled H&E cohorts. A semi-supervised Shared-Private Product-of-Experts Variational Information Bottleneck infers a consensus latent posterior across encoders while routing encoder-specific technical artifacts into orthogonal private latents via masked cross-view decoding. A logit-adjusted cosine classifier with inner-fold temperature scaling and macro-F1 threshold tuning predicts PAM50 subtypes. Repeated nested patient-level and 19-site-held-out cross-validation against null and linear baselines establishes broad, partial, site-confounded, or insufficient predictability.
preprocessing: Exclude all clinical (age, stage, histological_type), IHC receptor (er, pr, her2), RNA-derived, and site variables from predictors and preprocessing; retain patient_id for grouping and site solely for held-out site CV splits (A1).
Verify one-record-per-patient mean H&E vectors across multi-slide patients prior to splitting so all slides and tiles of every patient remain on one side of every fold and bootstrap resample (A2).

Inside each inner and outer training fold, pool labelled training patients with the 259 unlabelled H&E patients (excluding unlabelled patients from all validation/test scoring per A7), apply per-patient L2 normalization per encoder, center, and fit regularised whitened PCA (dim=256, shrinkage epsilon=1e-3) per encoder strictly on the training-fold pool (A3).
Compute empirical four-class PAM50 priors on labelled training-fold patients only for logit-adjusted training, post-hoc prior-consistent calibration, and null baselines.

training.convergence_rule: Require interior validation loss minimum or trailing 15-epoch ELBO slope below 1e-3 of initial loss drop before termination, logging per-epoch loss and macro-F1 curves (A6).

tuning.tie_breaker: 1-SE parsimony rule across inner folds preferring smaller shared_dim and higher beta_kl when differences fall within run-to-run spread.

sanity_checks: Assert zero forbidden features in model inputs
Assert zero patient overlap across splits
Verify null baselines match analytical class-prior entropy and zero minority recall before scoring

metrics: Out-of-fold four-class macro-F1 across 3x5 repeated nested patient CV with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 gain over majority-class and stratified class-prior null baselines with 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference versus inner-tuned single-encoder patient-mean balanced logistic regression reference with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Proportion of class-prior multi-class log-loss (Shannon entropy) explained out-of-fold with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Macro and per-class one-vs-rest AUROC across LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2 with 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs
Per-class recall, precision, and F1 for LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2 including LumA-versus-LumB confusion rates
19-site-held-out grouped CV out-of-fold macro-F1 and paired gain over chance with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Per-fold training ELBO, cross-view reconstruction, and inner-validation macro-F1 convergence trajectories
allowed_conclusions: Select strictly one pre-specified conclusion from 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs: Broad predictability if macro-F1 beats chance in both patient-level and 19-site-held-out CV and all four PAM50 subtypes individually beat chance; Partial predictability if macro-F1 beats chance in both CVs but at least one subtype fails to beat chance; Site-confounded predictability if patient-CV macro-F1 beats chance but the 19-site-held-out paired 95% CI over chance includes or falls below zero; or Insufficient evidence if the patient-CV paired 95% CI over chance includes or falls below zero. Additionally state whether multi-encoder variational disentanglement improves over the simple linear H&E reference within TCGA-BRCA scope only, claiming neither incremental gain over clinical variables nor biological causality.
rationale: Five encoders create 7,424 features for 802 patients alongside strong site confounding and 8.1% Her2 prevalence. Semi-supervised Product-of-Experts inference extracts cross-encoder morphological consensus while orthogonal private latents absorb scanner-specific artifacts without using site labels. Logit-adjusted cosine classification with inner-fold calibration protects minority recall and log-loss.

new_components.name: shared_private_poe_vib
new_components.description: Computes a semi-supervised multi-view Shared-Private Product-of-Experts Variational Information Bottleneck across M=5 patient-level encoder vectors (each 256-dim fold-whitened PCA). Inputs: 5 aligned patient vectors for labelled and unlabelled training-fold patients plus integer PAM50 labels for labelled training patients only (5 vectors per held-out labelled patient at inference). Architecture: M view-specific 2-layer LayerNorm-GELU-Dropout MLPs map each view m to shared diagonal Gaussian posterior parameters (mu_m, clamp(logvar_m, -6, 6)) in R^{shared_dim} and deterministic private latents z_priv_m in R^{private_dim}. Closed-form precision-weighted Product-of-Experts combines active views S with prior N(0,I): prec_poe = 1 + sum_{m in S} exp(-logvar_m), mu_poe = prec_poe^{-1} sum_{m in S} exp(-logvar_m)*mu_m. View decoders reconstruct all M views from [z_shared, z_priv_m] (substituting zero private vector for masked views m not in S). A cosine-normalized linear head with learnable scale maps z_shared (using deterministic mu_poe at test time) to 4 class scores f(z). Training: AdamW on mixed labelled+unlabelled mini-batches with random view masking (p=0.3, keeping >=2 views) and labelled latent mixup, minimizing logit-adjusted cross-entropy CE(f(z) + tau*log(pi_train), y) on labelled samples plus rec_weight*MSE across all M views, linearly warmed beta_kl*KL(q_poe||N(0,I)), and orth_weight*sum(||z_shared^T z_priv_m||_F^2 + 0.1*||z_priv_m||_2^2) on all training+unlabelled samples. After convergence, fits scalar temperature T>0 (inner-val NLL) for calibrated probabilities p_hat = softmax((f(mu_poe)+log(pi_train))/T) and simplex weights alpha in Delta^3 (coordinate ascent on inner-val macro-F1) for discrete predictions argmax_c(alpha_c * p_hat_c), averaging p_hat across n_seeds_ensemble seeds. Outputs: calibrated 4-class probabilities, macro-F1-calibrated class predictions, consensus embeddings, and epoch loss/metric curves.
